_doc: Instagram posting plan. THREE sections, one category each, every single day.
UPDATED 2026-08-14 (owner's rule): up to 14 rows per category across two slides,
a tier floor on Long Weekend, and a 75% international quota on Week-ish.
LONG WEEKEND  2-4 nights, out Thu/Fri, back Sun/Mon. tier_floor 2, so it draws from
the headline leisure cities and beaches — New York, Miami, Nashville,
New Orleans, Cancun — and only reaches the long tail if it would
otherwise come up short. It is no longer a list of whatever was cheap.
WEEK-ISH      6-21 nights leaving Thu-Sat, back any day. intl_quota 0.75, because a
week off is a holiday people plan around. Domestic still welcome when it
is a real destination; the leisure pool already removed the Little Rocks.
CHEAPEST      the lowest fares out of CLT at any shape. It reads as 'cheapest' because
it is, but it can only ever draw from the leisure pool, so it is the
cheapest way to somewhere people actually want to go — never the cheapest
flight to a random city.
NEVER AN OVERPAYMENT, ON ANY SLIDE. min_discount is 0.12 for the two trip shape sections
and 0.0 for CHEAPEST — zero, not negative.
A section that cannot find 14 shows fewer and prints the real count. Never padded.
A city may appear in more than one section on different dates, never twice in one
section, and the same exact flight never twice in one post.
Tiers live in config/tiers.json and control EXPOSURE, not eligibility.
`shapes` and `week` below are KEPT because render_reel.py still resolves a daily shape.

week.angle: A full week away, round trip, verified this morning.

weekend.angle: Out Thursday or Friday, back Sunday or Monday. A real long weekend, and you burn no vacation days.

urgent.angle: Long weekend shaped, leaving inside three weeks. Short window, real prices.

friday.angle: Expedia's 2026 Air Hacks Report puts Friday as the cheapest day of the week to book a flight, about 3% under Sunday, and the cheapest day to fly overall, up to 8% under a Sunday departure. Worth knowing: for US domestic routes specifically that report still has Tuesday as the cheapest day to actually fly, roughly 14% under Sunday.

twoweek.angle: The big one. Honeymoon, anniversary, the trip you keep putting off.

0.note: Monday. Peak booking day. The money post.

4.note: Friday. Cheapest day to book and fly, per Expedia 2026.

5.note: Saturday. PLAN: city guide carousel, build trust, do not sell. The guide renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board. Flip content to guide once it does.

6.note: Sunday. PLAN: inspiration plus a Monday teaser. Renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board.

alternating._doc: Every other Sunday the two week post replaces the usual Sunday content. Twice a month max, on purpose, so it stays special. Parity is on the ISO week number.

content_mix_target._doc: Three sections, every post, up to 14 rows each across two slides.

_dow: 0=Mon 1=Tue 2=Wed 3=Thu 4=Fri 5=Sat 6=Sun. depart_dow/return_dow are the days a trip may leave and come back on; omit either to mean any day. LADDER: a shape matching nothing relaxes to nights-only, then to the wide window. Every board row records which rung it landed on (row['rung']).

sections.angle: Out Thursday or Friday, back Sunday or Monday. A real long weekend, and you barely touch the working week.
Leave Thursday, Friday or Saturday and stay a week, or let it run into a second and a third. Mostly international, because a week off is a holiday you plan around.
The lowest fares leaving Charlotte right now. Not the cheapest flight to anywhere — the cheapest way to somewhere you actually want to go.
